title: lychnis miqueliana f. plena
intro: Lychnis miqueliana f. plena, commonly known as Double Flowered Lychnis, is a flowering plant species in the family Caryophyllaceae. This plant is known for its dense, double-petaled flowers in shades of pink and red, which are rich in medicinal properties. The health benefits of Lychnis miqueliana f. plena include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects.
